lines.en: Hey, do you want to go to dinner tonight?
I've got a date with that waitress, uh, Katie.
Yeah, I know we've only gone out, like, twice,
but I don't know, I have a really good feeling about her.
All right, just give me your wallet,
and there won't be a problem.
Oh, my God, I can't find my wallet!
All right, lady, no, give me your purse.
I knew you'd be my death, Phoebe Buffay!
I'm sorry, Ross, this is my old friend Lowell from the streets.
I can't believe you're still doing this.
So you look like you're doing really well.
I guess your mugging days are behind you.
Phoebe, you used to mug people?
Excuse me, Ross, I'm-- old friends catching up?
